name: Deeper
summary: Kayden Kross's director-driven Vixen Media Group imprint blending moody arthouse lighting, psychological drama, and intense, unhurried performances.
ranking_rationale: Arguably the strongest directorial voice in modern studio adult film—atmospheric, story-forward, and visually striking, with a smaller catalog than decade-old rivals.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; standalone or bundled inside Vixen Plus. Check official checkout.

pros: Distinctive moody cinematography and strong acting direction
Feature-length multi-part dramas alongside standalone scenes
Unusually high chemistry and pacing under Kayden Kross
Bundled into Vixen Plus alongside Vixen, Blacked, and Tushy
cons: Smaller back catalog than legacy networks
Slower narrative openings will not suit viewers skipping straight to action
Premium standalone pricing outside the Vixen Plus bundle

facts.value: Launched 2019 by Kayden Kross under Vixen Media Group
Paid subscription (standalone or Vixen Plus bundle)
Psychological drama, arthouse lighting, and feature-length narratives
